description: Default providers, in the order they are tried. internetArchive is last: it only has public-domain and Creative Commons films. hdhub4u (domain gone), vega and luxMovies (refuse data-centre IPs) were removed on 2026-11-07.
disabledByDefaultReason: Not verified for browser playback in the current live checks.
streamSourcesDescription: Playback sources tried together, in ranking order (STREAM_SOURCES in .env overrides it). desiflix, hdhub, censored and pengu are Stremio add-ons listed in STREMIO_ADDONS (pengu only with your own signed-in link); 4khdhub and internetArchive are vega-style providers and also need ENABLED_PROVIDERS.
